findings.evidence: Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Integral/Lebesgue/Countable.lean:131 provides lintegral_singleton without Countable; Basic.lean:258 provides setLIntegral_le_lintegral. Together they bound the integral below by the positive product already established at lines 65–67.
findings.fix: Remove Countable S from all three signatures. Bound the Chapman–Kolmogorov integral below by its integral over {y}, retaining MeasurableSingletonClass S.
findings.issue: The Countable S assumption unnecessarily excludes uncountable state spaces in Reaches.trans, Communicates.trans (line 82), and communicates_equivalence (line 92).

findings.evidence: Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Dirac/Def.lean:62 states dirac_apply_of_mem (h : a ∈ s) : dirac a s = 1 without a measurable-singleton assumption; apply it to x ∈ {x}.
findings.fix: Remove the assumption from both signatures and evaluate the zeroth-power Dirac mass using Measure.dirac_apply_of_mem.
findings.issue: MeasurableSingletonClass S is unnecessary for Reaches.refl and Communicates.refl (line 74), preventing reflexivity from being used on arbitrary measurable spaces.

summary: Reflexivity and transitivity carry unnecessary assumptions that restrict the communication API.
